hero.subtext: I'm skilled in developing mobile and web applications, database management and creating user-friendly interfaces. Passionate about learning new technologies and building practical software solutions.

about.paragraph1: I'm a Software Engineering student at COMSATS University Islamabad, Wah Campus. I build across mobile, web, and machine learning, from Flutter apps to Laravel backends to AI-driven features.
about.paragraph2: I enjoy exploring ideas, solving problems, and transforming concepts into clear, functional outcomes. Consistency, attention to detail, and continuous learning are what I try to bring to every project.
